carmen: spotted a burst of SSE reconnects after we tightened proxy idle_close in eu-canary :thinking_face:
yusuf: which metric jumped? streaming-quota-usage or reconnect-rate?
carmen: both. quota increments for the same resume token within seconds. console alarmed on streaming-heartbeat for 3 tenants
carmen: example trace:
```
[proxy] 2026-03-24T23:40:01Z host=px-eu idle_close=20s action=HALF_CLOSE conn=0x1a
[runtime] 2026-03-24T23:40:01Z session=s-77 resume=rt-77 kv_hit=true
[client] 2026-03-24T23:40:02Z reconnect resume=rt-77 -> new session created billable=true
```
elaine: I think HALF_CLOSE vs RST behavior varies by client. some SDKs keep resume context, others throw it away and force new session. messy when proxy nudges half-close earlier
yusuf: quick options: 1) runtime: treat rapid resume from same fingerprint as non-billable reattach, 2) proxy: avoid half-close when resume header present, 3) console: add short dedupe window so alerts don't flood ops
carmen: ops wants (3) immediately to stop noise. (1) is the long-term fix; (2) touches proxy pool logic and needs FF gating
elaine: runtime approach sketch: if resume_token exists and fingerprint matches and last_seen < 5s then attach and emit resume.reattach metric. add audit log for billing team to reconcile
yusuf: make token lookup O(1), and gate behind a feature flag runtime.ff.resume_reattach. add e2e for server-halfclose + client-resume behaviour
carmen: deploy-bot: can we queue a canary for runtime change?
deploy-bot: deploy requested: canary/runtime/resume-reattach -> queued on eng-runtime-canary
yusuf: I'll open PR with minimal handler change and tests. elaine please prepare proxy FF to suppress half-close if x-resume header present (default off) so we have a rollback path
elaine: ack. also adding console annotation: "Transient resume churn expected during canary" and mute streaming-heartbeat alerts for the 3 affected tenants for 60s
carmen: timeline: canary in ~45m. monitor resume.reattach, billing.delta, active_sockets_per_resume. update CS after first batch
yusuf: adding short-lived retro-dedupe job plan to fix any double-charges if they occurred during rollout window
carmen: thanks team. we'll reconvene if alerts spike again :thumbsup:
